title: Relax Fishing demo v0.3: added spinning, ledger fishing and a new UI. Would love your honest feedback
author: SeaworthinessFit6280
selftext:
Hi everyone, me again!

About a 3 week and a half ago I shared my fishing game here (I’m planning it for mobile) and asked for feedback. Since then I’ve fixed a lot of bugs, tweaked the mechanics and added ledger and spinning fishing. I also redid the whole interface, added new locations and rebalanced the economy.

I make the game with Claude and the graphics with ChatGPT, in my free time after work. So it’s going a bit slowly, but I’m doing my best 🙂

If anyone feels like it, please give it a try and tell me honestly what you think. I can see a few people keep playing it, and I’m really grateful for that. It keeps me motivated, because my goal is to finish the game and release it on Google Play and the App Store.

I know it’s a niche game and might not take off, but who would I be if I didn’t try 😄

Thanks, everyone!  
👉 [kholodniuk.itch.io/relax-fishing](http://kholodniuk.itch.io/relax-fishing)

comments.author: Recoil42
comments.body: Honestly, it just isn't ambitious enough. I'm worried for you if this is going slowly, because what you've produced is basically just a one-shot — re-think your development process if this is weeks (and many prompts) of work.

replies.author: SeaworthinessFit6280
replies.body: Fair point, thanks for being honest 🙂 Most of the time went into stuff you don't see at first glance — spinning and ledger fishing, fish behaviour per lake, market orders, gear setup, fight mechanics. But I get that from the first screen it looks simple. What would make it feel more ambitious to you — more visuals, more content, something else?

replies.author: Recoil42
replies.body:
>Most of the time went into stuff you don't see at first glance — spinning and ledger fishing, fish behaviour per lake, market orders, gear setup, fight mechanics.

All of these things could have been done in one prompt.

>What would make it feel more ambitious to you — more visuals, more content, something else?

Also: Don't use AI for your Reddit comments.

comments.author: Three_Tails_Studio
comments.body: Wild how many fishing games are in development. You REALLY need to stand out to have a chance in such a saturated genre. For example, Jan 1st - Oct 29th we have seen 268 games with the *fishing* tag released on Steam.
